description: The Client role cannot execute the sample request approval action.
validator_message: Client role cannot approve sample requests.
llm_prompt_instruction: Do not generate sample.approve_request for a Client.
healing_guidance: Route approval to a Workflow Builder, System Admin, or Platform Admin.

description: Sample requests above 1000 require a human approval checkpoint.
validator_message: Sample request amount above 1000 requires human approval.
llm_prompt_instruction: Add approval.request_human_approval when the amount is above 1000.
healing_guidance: Insert approval.request_human_approval before submitting the request.

description: Every sample request submission must identify its requester.
healing_guidance: Ask for the requester identity before regenerating the workflow.

description: High-risk sample actions require a human approval checkpoint.
llm_prompt_instruction: Include approval.request_human_approval before high-risk sample actions.
healing_guidance: Insert a human approval checkpoint before sample.approve_request.

rule_name: Sample requester and approver must differ
description: A person cannot approve their own sample request.
validator_message: requester_id and approver_id must be different.
llm_prompt_instruction: Ensure requester_id and approver_id refer to different people.
healing_guidance: Route the approval to a different authorized user.
